message.slumdrugs.withdrawal_2: Your hands will not keep still.
message.slumdrugs.press_full: The plate is loaded; work it or take it down.
message.slumdrugs.seal_bench_full: The bench holds one kind of goods at a time.
message.slumdrugs.seal_short: Not enough for a parcel: %s of %s units.
message.slumdrugs.tier_locked: A %s is beyond you until you reach %s.
message.slumdrugs.tier_reached: You have come up in the world: %s.
journal.slumdrugs.heading: Journal — %s
journal.slumdrugs.ceiling: The %s waits on standing and turf, which are not yet yours to earn.
message.slumdrugs.street_flooded: %s has had enough for now. The street is flooded.
message.slumdrugs.remedy_working: The last draught is still working.
message.slumdrugs.suspicion_watched: The Watch is asking about you.
message.slumdrugs.suspicion_hunted: Constables are looking for you by name.
message.slumdrugs.raid_called: The bell. The Watch will be at your door in two minutes. Carry nothing you would not explain.
message.slumdrugs.raid_lapsed: The bell falls silent. They have lost interest, for now.
message.slumdrugs.raided: The Watch turns you out and takes %s units of goods.
message.slumdrugs.cut_board_full: The board holds one kind of goods at a time.
message.slumdrugs.cut_heap_full: The heap is as high as it goes.
message.slumdrugs.cut_no_goods: Nothing on the board to cut.
message.slumdrugs.starting_purse: A purse of %s to start you off.
message.slumdrugs.no_smaller_coin: There is nothing smaller than a penny.
message.slumdrugs.graft_full: Both pots are taken; make the cross or take them back.
message.slumdrugs.graft_mismatch: The two parents must be the same plant.
advancements.slumdrugs.root.title: Hand to Mouth
advancements.slumdrugs.root.description: A seed, a frame and a rail to dry on. Everything starts here.
advancements.slumdrugs.tier.backroom.des: Twenty units sold. You have regulars now.
advancements.slumdrugs.tier.workshop.des: Sixty shillings earned. The presses and the machines are yours to set up.
advancements.slumdrugs.tier.apothecary.d: Not yet reachable: it waits on standing and turf.
advancements.slumdrugs.tier.guild.title: The Guild
advancements.slumdrugs.station.counting_: Set up a counting house desk.
advancements.slumdrugs.station.cutting_b: Set up a cutting bench. Your regulars will notice.
message.slumdrugs.tonic.overdose: Too much tonic. You need to sit down.
message.slumdrugs.taken_in: The Watch takes you in. %s seconds in the cell, or %s stamped for bail.
message.slumdrugs.released: The cell door opens. Off you go.
message.slumdrugs.bailed: Bail paid. The clerk writes your name down.
message.slumdrugs.bail_loose: The magistrate does not take loose coin. Stamped, or wait.
message.slumdrugs.bribed: %s pockets the %s and forgets %s worth of what they saw.
message.slumdrugs.bribe_stamped: %s will not take coin with a name on it.
message.slumdrugs.customer_lost: %s turns away. Word of that will reach the Watch.
message.slumdrugs.street_sale_poor: %s pays %s for %s %s, and grumbles about the quality.
message.slumdrugs.street_sale_cut: %s pays %s for %s %s. Tomorrow they will be sick, and they will know why.
message.slumdrugs.street_sale_last: %s pays %s for %s %s. That was the last time.
journal.slumdrugs.bribes: %s constables paid off. Each one is a name in a book somewhere.
message.slumdrugs.line_named: The line has a name now: %s.
tooltip.slumdrugs.line_ready: Held %s generations. Name it at an anvil and plant it.
message.slumdrugs.clean_streak: %s days clean. Your body forgets a little: tolerance can reach %s at most now.
message.slumdrugs.treatment_short: The treatment is %s stamped. That is %s.
message.slumdrugs.treatment_working: You are still under care from the last one.
message.slumdrugs.treated: %s sees to you. Dependence down to %s.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.lost.2: Keep walking. I've said what I'll say.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.lost.3: The Watch has a nose. So do I.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.nervous.1: Not now. Half the street is looking at you.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.nervous.2: Come back when it's quieter. Please.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.nervous.3: You've got eyes on you. I've got a family.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.devoted.1: There you are. Same as always?
bark.slumdrugs.customer.devoted.2: I'd have waited all day for you.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.devoted.3: Set some aside for me. You know I'm good for it.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.warm.1: Good to see you. That last batch was fine work.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.warm.2: You're the only one around here who doesn't cheat me.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.cool.1: Last time wasn't worth what I paid.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.cool.2: I've had better. I've had better from you.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.cool.3: I'm not sure about you anymore.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.wanting.1: I can see what's in that bag.
bark.slumdrugs.customer.wanting.2: I know what you're carrying. Name a price.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.hot.1: Walk on. I don't know you today.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.hot.2: Not here. Not while they're watching you.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.hot.3: Come back with the heat off you.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.flooded.1: The street's drowning in the stuff. I'm not paying full.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.flooded.2: Everyone's selling. Nobody's buying. Sit on it a while.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.flooded.3: You can smell it on every corner. Prices are down.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.hungry.1: Dry as a bone out there. Whatever you've got, I'll take.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.hungry.2: Bring me anything. I'll pay what it's worth today.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.hungry.3: Nobody's had a thing in days. Good time to be you.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.idle.2: Show me something worth my time.
bark.slumdrugs.broker.idle.3: Sealed goods only, if you want the good price.
bark.slumdrugs.trader.rain.1: Frostroot loves this weather. Sunleaf hates it.
bark.slumdrugs.trader.rain.2: Rain's good for the roots and bad for the loft.
bark.slumdrugs.trader.rain.3: You'll want the bundles under cover in this.
bark.slumdrugs.trader.new.2: Start with sunleaf. It forgives mistakes.
bark.slumdrugs.trader.new.3: Keep your best harvest for seed. Everyone learns that too late.
bark.slumdrugs.trader.regular.1: Back for more? The frames must be full.
bark.slumdrugs.trader.regular.2: Compost. Don't skimp on the compost.
bark.slumdrugs.trader.regular.3: I hear your line is coming along.
bark.slumdrugs.healer.worried.1: Your hands are shaking. Come and see me.
bark.slumdrugs.healer.worried.2: I can help, if you'll let me. Stamped coin, and some honesty.
bark.slumdrugs.healer.worried.3: How long since you slept properly?
bark.slumdrugs.healer.gentle.1: You look tired. Rest helps more than you'd think.
bark.slumdrugs.healer.gentle.2: A remedy draught, and a night's sleep. That's all I'll say.
bark.slumdrugs.healer.idle.1: Nothing wrong with you that I can see. Keep it that way.
bark.slumdrugs.healer.idle.3: Come by if it ever gets away from you.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.hunted.1: I know your face. I know your name.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.hunted.2: It's a matter of time now.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.hunted.3: Every parcel's got a seal on it. Think about that.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.watched.1: I've been hearing things about you.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.watched.2: Careful where you go at night.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.watched.3: You're on a list. Not a long one.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.noticed.3: Nothing to see here, I hope.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.bought.1: Evening. Nothing to report, as ever.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.bought.2: I saw nothing. I keep seeing nothing.
bark.slumdrugs.constable.bought.3: The book's got your name in it, you know. Just in case.
bark.slumdrugs.crew.demanding.3: Coin, or we do this the other way.
bark.slumdrugs.crew.wary.3: Keep your hands where I can see them.
bark.slumdrugs.crew.friendly.1: Good to see you. Boss says you're all right.
bark.slumdrugs.resident.hot.2: The Watch came asking about you.
bark.slumdrugs.resident.hot.3: Not in front of the children, please.
bark.slumdrugs.resident.night.3: Mind the lamps. They go out.
